{{Quote|I had seen your master fight, long ago. He was too dangerous to capture--exposure to the void of space was a suitable fate.|Darth Vader explains his reason for executing the Jedi Master|<ref name="TTF1" />}}
A '''male Jedi Master''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], becoming a key member of the [[Vaklin insurgency]] at the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Taking on a [[Unidentified reptilian Jedi Knight|Padawan]], they served together in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and both avoided execution during the initial stages of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] ascent to power. Together with his former student and Jedi [[Cho'na Bene]] they went into hiding on [[Vaklin]], a very pro-Jedi world.<ref name="TTF1" />

A key member of the [[Vaklin insurgency]], he was the first to be captured by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Surrendering and taken prisoner by the Sith, Vader believed that the man was far too good of a swordsman to be taken alive and dumped him out an airlock as a form of execution.<ref name="TTF1" />
